brief_rationale: The doctor conducted a thorough headache red-flag screen, corrected the family’s misconception that a coronary stent meant an intracranial stent, prevented NSAID use with clopidogrel, classified medications by function, gave concrete neuro-consult follow-up with explicit preparation and addressed care-access barriers. All seven responsibility-chain items were met without serious or minor error. Four case-defined high-order points (HO1–HO4) were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact through beyond-minimum actions that integrated findings into the plan and communication. The trajectory therefore meets Strong with no in-chain error and at least one completed HO, and qualifies for Perfect because multiple HO points are fully satisfied and closure is safe, executable, and traceable.
